messages:
Riya (Finance): Quick clarification for teams: contractor/consultant spend counting toward PO/SOW thresholds is cumulative across the engagement, not per invoice. New guidance goes live Mon Jul 20. Short summary below + Confluence link: https://confluence.redwood/finance/contractor-guidance :loudspeaker:

Tom (Eng): Helpful. Example: if we pay a consultant $1,200/month via card for 6 months = $7,200 total, so we need a PO & SOW?

Diego (Procurement): Correct. Any engagement expected to exceed $5k total requires a PO and SOW before milestone/aggregate payments exceed that threshold. If you expect steady monthly card charges, open a procurement ticket to create an engagement ID so we can monitor cumulative spend.

Marta (Legal): Note: if the consultant will access production or customer data, Legal needs to sign off on data handling clauses in the SOW even if the dollar amount is below $5k. Mark tickets with "legal: data access" when relevant.

Riya (Finance): Also: short-lived cards for one-off testing purchases under $1,500 remain allowed, but Procurement will flag repeated charges from the same consultant and may convert to PO/SOW.

expense-bot: New rule recorded: contractor_threshold_cumulative = $5000; auto-flag on 3rd monthly charge if projected total > threshold. (REF: CTOR-2026-07) :gear:

Tom (Eng): If the work is hourly and variable, can Procurement create a not-to-exceed PO rather than a full SOW? That would speed us up.

Diego (Procurement): Yes. Not-to-exceed POs are supported for variable hourly engagements. Still need a brief scope and estimated cap; Procurement will attach a standard NYE (not-to-exceed) addendum template. For longer consulting relationships we prefer SOWs.

Riya (Finance): Action items: teams with active contractors hitting month 3 of recurring card payments should open a ticket this week to confirm engagement IDs. We'll post a short FAQ and a 15-min office hour slot tomorrow. :calendar:

Tom (Eng): Thanks, opening a ticket now.

Marta (Legal): We'll prep a short checklist for tickets that require data clauses.

Diego (Procurement): If you need a same-week exception (e.g., contractor already started and payments exceed threshold), open ticket with subject "PROCURE-RETRO-CTOR" and include manager signoff. Exceptions reviewed case-by-case.

Riya (Finance): Thanks everyone. Reminder that proper ticketing saves time and avoids invoice returns. :white_check_mark:
